claim: GPR-8 showed a provisional historical candidate-ranking signal but has not yet passed its frozen prospective falsification gate.
Raw repeat and adjacent-number conditional rates in the long historical sample are approximately consistent with the 0.10 fair baseline and do not support standalone predictive authority.
SLDV is properly treated as a combination-morphology feature rather than a standalone main-number prediction expert.
The reconstructed slot-first HLR/VVD funnel and winner-float architecture requires independent reproduction; current three-draw replay is post-hoc and non-confirmatory.
A PowerBall-specific mechanical-to-electronic draw boundary on 2026-06-22 is not supported; PowerBall is reported as Khaya on both 2026-06-19 and 2026-06-23.
HEPS must model game format, draw method, and machine identity as separate provenance concepts when evaluating physical or machine-specific hypotheses.

Exact 5/50 order-statistic HLR/VVD and joint-vector distributions are required methodological baselines for learned slot-dynamics claims; this is a mathematical/control result, not predictive lottery edge.

MAIN_HLR_SLOT and MAIN_VVD_DELTA have not demonstrated predictive information beyond the exact structural order-statistic null; prospective proper-score comparison is required before additional authority.

The corrected six-component gap vector is a one-to-one state representation of legal sorted 5/50 lines, and the IID gap null is exactly Dirichlet-Multinomial(45,[1,1,1,1,1,1]), uniform over all legal weak compositions; this is methodological geometry, not predictive evidence.
Forecastable temporal information in MAIN_GAP_VECTOR or MAIN_GAP_RESIDUAL beyond NULL_GAP_DM has not been demonstrated and must remain experimental.

The retrospective Candidate Lattice realized joint-flow ranks 3/243, 8/243, and 8/243 are not standalone evidence of predictive skill: exact IID joint-null ranks for those realized vectors were 2, 26, and 3 respectively, so two of three are explained at least as well by structural geometry.
E0003's first prospective exact VVD point hypotheses for 2026-08-14 missed Slots1,3,5; the observed common +2 residual is post-draw only and receives zero retrospective credit.
HEPS should score global candidate inclusion separately from exact-slot assignment; a coordinate retained in the wrong sorted slot may receive candidate credit but not exact-slot forecast credit.

A JOS-HDR exact-line density mask under NULL_GAP_DM is invalid because all legal six-gap compositions are equiprobable under the IID 5/50 null; a fixed K22 without predictive information has only about 1.243% 5/5 survival probability.

Joint slot/gap compatibility remains a legitimate research question only after exact combinatorial base-rate correction; the repaired E0006 feature-class residual approach has no predictive or pruning authority yet.

The director-reported 2026-08-14 XTRA overlap with Main winners 14,39,44 is insufficient to infer cross-game predictability; only prospectively frozen matched-exposure rescue tests may establish value.

MAIN_NONEQUILIBRIUM_CURRENT showed enough post-June current-era replay lift to justify a cheap candidate-funnel shadow score, but not enough absolute evidence for production authority or a claim of physical nonequilibrium dynamics.

MAIN_LEVY_TAIL_DIAGNOSTIC is useful only as a structural-null-relative tail-pressure diagnostic; its full-window candidate performance was essentially random and it has no candidate-ranking or rescue authority.

XTRA_RICHARDSON_PAIR_DISPERSION is the strongest physics-derived XTRA main-number candidate lead from the post-June taste test and is admitted as a distribution-first shadow field only; production authority awaits prospective fixed-exposure evidence.

For the 2026-09-01 Main target, the frozen BARP modal HLR vector LLHHL exactly matched the realized five-slot direction vector LLHHL. This is positive one-target prospective evidence for scenario preservation, not enough for expert promotion or parameter retuning.

The 2026-09-01 Main draw strengthens the distinction between anywhere-coordinate evidence and exact-slot provenance: coordinate14 was strongly ranked pre-draw in S2 but realized in S1, while 16 had strong adjacent S1/S2 support and realized in S2. Fixed-K adjacent-slot preservation is therefore a legitimate prospective research question.

HLR, VVD, exact target coordinate and terminal digit are deterministic views of one sorted-slot signed transition and must not be multiplied or counted as independent expert evidence. New Main acquisition research should use one regularized transition representation and coherent legal-line normalization.

E0019's complete-line containment objective M(K) is worth retaining, but its historical HLR×VVD residual-product field is superseded because it double-counts one transition information family and was worse than flat on proper score.

E0020 terminal motifs remain diagnostic only: S3 terminal1 and S4 terminal4 were top-1 hits on 2026-09-01, but historical suffix models and the terminal×HLR×VVD chain failed proper-score and multiplicity gates. One successful target does not override those controls.

Proper-score improvement of a full-support candidate probability field is a primary promotion gate before raw optimized K13/K20 recall may be interpreted as predictive lift. Better basket recall with a worse probability field can be optimization over misspecification.

For the 2026-09-04 Main target, frozen slotwise BARP modal HLR LHLHH matched four of five realized direction signs; actual was LLLHH. Together with the 2026-09-01 5/5 directional hit this supports continued prospective BARP evaluation, but still does not establish residual predictive information beyond exact structural HLR nulls or justify retuning.

The superseded E0026-R 2026-09-04 K13 retained actual winners38 and50, and both realized in their pre-draw primary routed slots S4 and S5. This is useful one-target shadow evidence for preserving candidate-plus-slot provenance, but the arm remains INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE because its earlier probability-field proper score was worse than uniform and one draw cannot establish fixed-K lift.

The E0028 LDSAD discovery band 11..13 scored its first fresh prospective target on 2026-09-04 with realized LDSAD11. This is one prospective shadow success only; the band remains discovery-selected, multiplicity-exposed, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, and has no production hard-pruning authority.

For the first fresh E0029 target on 2026-09-04, exact-winning-line gate/rank performance is not attributable because the frozen official K13 excluded four of five winning coordinates upstream. E0029 therefore remains prospective shadow with no new hard-pruning authority rather than receiving a win or loss from an impossible downstream line.
